{"number":2477,"title":"Audio device passthrough (virtio-snd) from macOS host to VMs and containers","body":"**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**\n\nNot a blocker — more of a growing nice-to-have. Voice input is becoming a standard way to drive AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), and anything I run inside an OrbStack-managed\ncontainer currently can\u0026#39;t access a microphone. My whole dev environment lives in containers, so voice is the one feature where I\u0026#39;d have to break that pattern.\n\n**Describe the solution you\u0026#39;d like**\n\nAudio device passthrough from the macOS host into OrbStack VMs and containers. Concretely:\n\n- **Host VM**: attach a virtio-sound input device to the Linux VM using Apple\u0026#39;s `Virtualization.framework` audio APIs (`VZVirtioSoundDeviceConfiguration`, available since macOS 13).\n- **Permissions**: OrbStack\u0026#39;s helper process to declare `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription` and trigger a TCC prompt the first time a VM requests mic input.\n- **Guest kernel**: ensure `snd-virtio` is enabled in the OrbStack guest kernel so `/dev/snd/*` and `/proc/asound` are populated in the VM.\n- **Container surface**: document (or add a first-class flag for) passing `/dev/snd` into containers via `--device /dev/snd`, so containerized tools can record without extra plumbing.\n\nInput is the high-value direction; output passthrough would be a nice bonus.\n\n**Describe alternatives you\u0026#39;ve considered**\n\n- **Run AI agents natively on macOS** — defeats the purpose. Everything else (toolchain, project, env, secrets) lives in my container; splitting the agent off means losing the file/PATH/env context that makes it useful.\n- **PulseAudio-over-TCP from Mac to container** — technically possible but fragile. PulseAudio on macOS is unmaintained, the connection breaks across sleep cycles, and it\u0026#39;s a non-trivial setup per project.\n\n**Additional context**\n\n- Apple\u0026#39;s `Virtualization.framework` has supported audio device configuration since macOS 13 (2022), so the underlying primitive is already there.\n- Linux has shipped the `snd-virtio` driver since kernel 5.14.\n- Docker Desktop has the same gap, so this would be a meaningful differentiator for OrbStack.\n- Beyond voice agents, the same plumbing unlocks audio testing, transcription pipelines, and browser audio E2E tests inside containers","state":"closed","state_reason":"completed","html_url":"https://github.com/orbstack/orbstack/issues/2477","user":{"login":"boywijnmaalen","id":3985741,"profile_url":"https://github.com/boywijnmaalen","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/3985741?v=4"},"author_association":"NONE","labels":["t/feature"],"assignees":[],"milestone":"v2.2.0","comments":2,"reactions":{"total_count":1,"+1":1,"-1":0,"laugh":0,"confused":0,"heart":0,"hooray":0,"rocket":0,"eyes":0},"created_at":"2026-05-21T05:42:48Z","updated_at":"2026-06-04T12:55:54Z","closed_at":"2026-05-23T12:31:01Z","closed_by":"kdrag0n","has_parent":false,"has_children":false,"closed_by_pull_requests":{"total_count":0,"references":[]}}
